title_en: Near the airport, 1+1 apartment for sale with perfect orientation in a new building!!!
description_en: Near the airport, super apartment 1+1 for sale, with a regular floor plan!!! The property is located on the 2nd floor of a 10-story building and has a total area of ​​69.8 m2, of which 60 m2 is net area. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. Currently, the construction is in the final stage and has high quality in construction. The facility will be delivered in June 2026. The complex will have recreational spaces and playgrounds for children. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
